name: No Supply No Demand Bar
note: Volume Spread Analysis read of an ABSENCE of participation: a narrow-range bar whose volume undercuts each of the previous two bars, closing in the half of its range that contradicts its own direction, taken only in the matching side of the SMA. Mandatory confirmation on the very next bar (close through the signal bar's extreme on higher volume) turns the qualitative read into a rule.
source: Tom Williams, 'Master the Markets' (Volume Spread Analysis). Operational definition -- up/down bar, narrow spread, volume lower than the previous two bars, close position within the bar, confirming next bar on rising volume -- from tradingsetupsreview.com's VSA guide and atas.net's no-demand/no-supply article. 'Narrow spread' is undefined in both sources and is pinned here to a fraction of the mean range of the five bars before the signal bar.
